info.title: FactCheck API
info.description:
Live FactCheck API.

The canonical OpenAPI document is https://factcheck-mim7.onrender.com/openapi.json. Agent instructions: https://factcheck-mim7.onrender.com/llms.txt. MCP server: https://factcheck-mim7.onrender.com/mcp.

POST /check and POST /v1/verify accept the same body. Send `text` or `claims`. Set `async` to true to start a background job, then poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}.

One free check per client, no key required. Paid plans are coming soon. Paid keys, when they go on sale, will use the Authorization or X-API-Key header. Buying credits is not available yet.

Verdicts, from strongest support to least: supported, hypothesis (supported by evidence), opinion, conflicting, unverified. Each claim may carry `verdict_detail`: `likely_true` or `speculative` for hypothesis, `contradicted` for conflicting. Older results may still use `likely_true` or `contradicted` as the verdict. A supported verdict requires a quoted passage or a tool result. Opinions are reported as what mainstream fact-checkers say, not as true or false. A verdict is not proof.
